verdict.rationale: Docs describe running tasks in parallel in the cloud, browsing active/completed chats, resuming sessions, and delegating to specialized agents from CLI/web/desktop, which supports managing multiple concurrent agent sessions. However, the 'unified workspace' spans separate surfaces (CLI, web, desktop app) rather than one integrated view, and community reports cite friction (app stuck loading projects, mac-only limitations, paper cuts) suggesting the experience is not seamless.
